caption: Global Metadata: Mandarin acoustic folk pop, 90 BPM, C major, 4/4, warm and clear, an educational song. Each verse and chorus is performed only once. Finish after the last supplied lyric with a resolved cadence. Brief intro and brief resolved outro. C-Am-F-G and C-G-Am-F harmony, Dm7-G7-C final cadence. Vocal Details: one natural warm male lead singer, exceptionally clear standard Mandarin pronunciation with distinct syllable initial consonants, unhurried syllables, smooth connected vowels, comfortable mid-range, every lyric line sung exactly once in order. Arrangement: acoustic guitar rhythm, soft piano chords, warm bass and gentle brushed drums, sparse supportive accompaniment, restrained fills.
